description.en:
Experimental AI farm manager. Farm Agent is the brain, FS25's own AI workers are the hands.
Alt+J menu: harvest all ready crops, prepare fields (plow / cultivate), plant a crop, replant, fertilize, lime, do all field work, autopilot on/off, pause, stop - or type a command. - Scans owned fields: crop, growth, ground type, fertilizer / lime / plow levels - Built-in brain decides what each field needs and which tractor + tool or combine does it - Starts vanilla AI field work; sends tractor + trailer under the pipe and to the silo - Verifies every job by measuring the field, recovers stalls, escalates to you when stuck - Autopilot: endless loop - every free machine gets the most useful job it can do now (harvest, plow or cultivate, plant what is in season, fertilize, lime); fertilizing and liming can be switched off; no plow free = cultivate instead - Machines are driven off the field after their job (back to where you parked them) - Farm memory: learns each combine's pipe position and each field's last crop
Hotkeys (rebindable): Alt+J menu, Alt+K cycle panel, Alt+L pause/resume, Alt+End stop all agent work. Optional: run the companion script to have Claude interpret free-form commands.
Singleplayer / host only.
